title: std/db-change@1
description: One row change from a database change-data-capture skill (e.g. example/sensorial/postgres-cdc) — one envelope per row change, not per transaction.

columns.description: Column name -> value. For "delete", and for "update" unless the source table is REPLICA IDENTITY FULL, this is only the replica-identity columns (the primary key, by default) — a property of the source database, not data the skill lost.

lsn.description: The source's log sequence number for this change, if the skill exposes one — for external resumability, not something the kernel interprets.
